The '''Flying Color Guard''' was a group based on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Their members were generally members of the [[Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps/Legends|Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps]].<ref name="Galaxies" />

Between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{SWG timeline}}</ref> the group's [[President/Legends|president]] was a local celebrity by the name of [[Kaydine]], he was a highly decorated member of the Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps.<ref name="Galaxies" />
